objective: Analyze the environmental baseline for the Goldstream Honeyworks apiary (2844 Sooke Lake RD, Langford, BC V9B 4R3). Use RADARSAT SAR backscatter to map soil moisture levels throughout the year. Cross-reference with historical datasets to identify and map soil disturbance zones caused by forest fires and local construction projects within a 3km foraging radius.
constraints: Focus on the specific GPS coordinates of the apiary as the center point.
Use SAR VV/VH polarization ratios to estimate volumetric soil moisture.
Classify disturbance zones into: 'Severe Fire Scar', 'Construction Compaction', and 'Undisturbed Forest'.
Output the data as sparse float16 binary patches for the volunteer mesh to repair and interpolate.
